goalSummary: In the Runs table, Claude session titles display raw leading characters of the original prompt instead of a concise summarized description.

facts.why: The specific flag scoping backfill to Claude sessions only must be documented
The function that synthesizes summary titles via LLM must be named
The Claude-path function falling back to heuristic signal.title must be identified as the regression source
The heuristic fallback field producing verbatim prompt text must be named
The backfill mode flag that re-titles sessions outside the active window must be documented
The file implementing claudePass, llmSessionTitle call path, and backfill logic must be identified
